title: UE-initiated NAS transport of messages not accepted by the network

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used to carry various payload types including N1 SM information, CIoT user data, SMS, and LPP messages.

entities.name: Payload container type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of payload being transported (N1 SM information, CIoT user data container, SMS, LPP message container).

entities.name: Request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of request (initial request, existing PDU session, MA PDU request, modification request).

entities.name: DNN based congestion control
entities.description: Condition where congestion control is activated for a specific DNN, preventing message forwarding.

entities.name: S-NSSAI and DNN based congestion control
entities.description: Condition where congestion control is activated for specific S-NSSAI and DNN combination, preventing message forwarding.

entities.name: S-NSSAI only based congestion control
entities.description: Condition where congestion control is activated for specific S-NSSAI only, preventing message forwarding.

entities.name: Timer T3447 running
entities.description: Condition where timer T3447 is active and UE does not support service gap control.

entities.name: Maximum PDU sessions reached
entities.description: Condition where PLMN's maximum number of PDU sessions has been reached for the UE.

entities.name: CIoT user plane resources limit
entities.description: Condition where UE has reached maximum number of supported user-plane resources in NB-N1 mode with user plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: NSSAA pending
entities.description: Condition where AMF is performing Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization for the S-NSSAI.

entities.name: UAS services not allowed
entities.description: Condition where UE is marked in 5GMM context as not allowed to request UAS services.

entities.name: AMF rejection action
entities.description: Procedure where AMF sends back the message that was not forwarded with appropriate 5GMM cause and optionally a back-off timer.

entities.name: Procedure abort
entities.description: Procedure where AMF aborts the NAS transport procedure without forwarding the message.

relations.description: UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Payload container type IE.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Request type IE.
AMF rejection action is triggered when DNN based congestion control is activated.
AMF rejection action is triggered when S-NSSAI and DNN based congestion control is activated.
AMF rejection action is triggered when S-NSSAI only based congestion control is activated.
AMF rejection action is triggered when timer T3447 is running and UE does not support service gap control.
AMF rejection action is triggered when maximum number of PDU sessions is reached.
AMF rejection action is triggered when CIoT user plane resources limit is reached.
AMF rejection action is triggered when NSSAA is pending for the S-NSSAI.
AMF rejection action is triggered when UE is not allowed to request UAS services.
Procedure abort is triggered when timer T3447 is running for SMS or LPP messages.
